detail.longDescription: # TodayInTheClassroom : First year chem are learning about how to read chemical formulas and molar mass. They'll use their periodic tables to calculate molar mass of compounds for practice. Comp sci is continuing with hardware, doing some binary/decimal conversions, and start to learn about Internet traffic routing. AP chem is finishing a lab practicing taking precise measurements and performing calculations with sig figs. # teaching # chemistry # webdev :cupofcoffee:
